summary: All 7155 tests pass. Formatting issues in 5 files fixed (ruff format). One pre-existing design gap noted regarding config propagation to Docker build context.

issues_found.description: 5 files had ruff formatting issues: sandbox/docker-setup.py, sandbox/egg_lib/docker.py, tests/config/test_repo_config.py, tests/sandbox/test_docker.py, tests/sandbox/test_docker_setup.py. These caused `make lint` to fail.
issues_found.fix: Ran `ruff format` on all 5 files. Commit 8bf3a1600.

issues_found.description: Design gap (pre-existing pattern): docker-setup.py's load_config() cannot find repositories.yaml during Docker build because the config file (~/.config/egg/repositories.yaml) is not copied into the build context (~/.cache/egg/). This means build_commands are never executed during image builds. However, this is the same pre-existing pattern used by extra_packages — not a regression introduced by this PR. The watch_files caching layer and build hash computation work correctly on the host side.
issues_found.fix: No fix applied — this is a pre-existing design pattern. A follow-up issue could add config propagation (e.g., copy a build commands manifest JSON into the build context alongside repo-deps/).
